1: const MAX_DELAY_MS = 300_000;
2: const DELTA_SECONDS_RE = /^[0-9]+$/;
3: 
4: export function parseRetryAfter(value, nowMs) {
5:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return null;
6:   const trimmed = value.trim();
7:   if (!trimmed) return null;
8:   if (DELTA_SECONDS_RE.test(trimmed)) return Number(trimmed) * 1000;
9:   const dateMs = Date.parse(trimmed);
10:   if (!Number.isFinite(dateMs) || !Number.isFinite(nowMs)) return null;
11:   return Math.max(0, dateMs - nowMs);
12: }
13: 
14: export function computeRetryDelay({ attempt, retryAfter, nowMs }) {
15:   if (!Number.isInteger(attempt) || attempt < 1) throw new Error('attempt must be a positive integer');
16:   if (!Number.isFinite(nowMs)) throw new Error('nowMs must be finite');
17:   const retryAfterMs = parseRetryAfter(retryAfter, nowMs);
18:   if (retryAfterMs !== null) return Math.min(MAX_DELAY_MS, retryAfterMs);
19:   return Math.min(MAX_DELAY_MS, 1000 * 2 ** (attempt - 1));
20: }
